en: The postcard shows a colorful, vintage map of a city at the bottom, with a boy in traditional Austrian clothing leaning over the top of the map. Behind him is a picturesque hill with a historic clock tower (the Uhrturm) and a castle-like building, suggesting a scenic view. There are wine bottles on the map, and above the map is some German text pointing to a restaurant or cellar. At the bottom, there is a red greeting in German.
